description: This file is a shell script for testing the standalone http status behavior of gitweb, a web interface for Git, executing various HTTP status code checks, configuration setups, and other environment preparations related to gitweb.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the test based on Perl modules available.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting certain output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for testing snapshot creation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Provides a timestamp to create distinct commits.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run upon test completion.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the gitweb script with specified parameters.
